opening.argument: The recording is presented as a test of purported tech-support callers, not as a promotion of their service: the uploader says they “scambait any \"tech support\" people who happen to call me” and warns viewers, “DO NOT FOLLOW ANY LINKS IN THE VIDEO.” The requests for computer access, paid support and personal details belong to that recorded interaction and are made by the caller. The uploader also challenges the caller’s technical account, stating that “The services that weren't running are completely unnecessary.” Taken together, the stated purpose, explicit warning and critical response show an investigation of the caller’s claims rather than an effort to solicit viewers for the offered service.
